title: Evergreen Dream | KEY.co
description_expanded: The heart of the home is on the second floor, where a gourmet kitchen, complete with high-end appliances and rich wood cabinetry, opens onto a spacious living area. This layout encourages togetherness and ease, allowing for memorable gatherings and serene moments alike. Multiple balconies, including one with alfresco dining and a gas grill, offer stunning views and extend the living space outdoors, blending indoor comfort with the allure of waterfront breezes. The pinnacle of relaxation awaits on the third floor, where the master suite offers breathtaking glimpses of the water from its private balcony, enhanced by a luxurious bathroom featuring a soaking tub and dual vanities. With full access to WaterColor community amenities and multiple balconies to enjoy the view, this home is not just a place to stay—it's a gateway to a luxurious coastal lifestyle. Set against the picturesque backdrop of the Gulf District, this stunning WaterColor residence offers an idyllic escape with views of the water that promise to enchant. Situated just moments from the Beach Club and a private beach, the home is perfectly positioned for effortless coastal living. Spanning three levels, this property boasts five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, and a trundle space, accommodating up to 14 guests in comfort and style. The ground floor presents a trio of beautifully appointed guest rooms, including one with a king-sized bed and private bath, making it an inviting retreat after a day by the sea. A convenient laundry room with an ice maker adds a touch of practical luxury, ensuring every need is met.
